create_Executor_model: create an Executor model with args, resource bins, unit types, and command types for behavior cloning
run_parse_hist_inst: parse historical instruction tensors into parsed history, lengths, and diffs using an instruction dictionary
run_create_loss_masks: create real unit masks and command type masks for computing per-unit behavior cloning loss
run_compute_loss: compute the multi-head behavior cloning loss including command type, move, attack, gather, and build losses
run_compute_prob: compute action probabilities for all command heads given a batch of game state features
